decision.reason: [ev-eb81b209b10e] is only a changelog line, "feat: upgrade to v1.32.2 (#22168)". It doesn't name what was upgraded, the version before the change, or any change in behavior or compatibility. Without that, nobody can work out the subject, the change, who is exposed or what happens to them. The PR #22168 or a matching artifact diff (for example, the go.mod dependency versions) is needed to pin down which component moved and whether operators are affected.
